title: Legacy map for suite beta8-384e

legacy.title: Beta.10 evidence for keyword-gated Mistral, Cohere, Deepgram, AI21 and Exa keys (#384, slice e)
legacy.description: Fixtures for five context-gated arrival families with no documented key format (research #781, #782, #789, #784, #787; product redact-secret#868): positives beside a provider name, host or SDK constructor, context twins that keep the value and remove the gate, and independent benign controls. AI21 and Exa carry pending (T0) contracts. Values are synthetic, never provider-issued. Measures and records; moves no support status by itself.
